items.title: STERIS (NYSE:STE) Posts Q2 CY2026 Sales In Line With Estimates
items.summary: Medical equipment and services company Steris (NYSE:STE) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.3% year on year to $1.49 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.59 per share was 3.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
